name: Savings goal planner
audience: People saving for more than one goal at the same time.
summary: Work out the monthly amount for several goals from the target, the saved balance, and the months left.
description: Each goal has its own row. Monthly required is the gap divided by the months you enter. The workbook sums those monthly amounts so you can see whether payday can carry all of them.
benefits: See the monthly amount per goal
Add the goals before you promise all of them
Keep a saved balance so you do not start from zero by mistake
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
